subject: Tiered VM evidence, scan cadence and SLA sculpting
messages:
From: Jenna Lowe <jenna.lowe@blueridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueRidge Compliance Team <compliance@blueridge.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM evidence for SIG/CAIQ review (scan cadence / SLA exceptions)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the call yesterday. BlueRidge is kicking off our SIG/CAIQ evidence collection and our auditors asked for a compact package showing the following for Redwood:
- scan cadence by asset tier (prod, staging, infra)
- SLA for CVE remediation by severity and any documented exception windows
- evidence of recent remediation (patch manifests or tickets) for CVEs flagged in May/June 2027
- confirmation of any legacy dependency exceptions and compensating controls

Can you send a single thread with the artifacts and a short attestation we can include in our SIG packet? We need this by EOD Friday (7/16) if possible.

Also: would Redwood accept a 45-day closure window for non-privileged CVEs if compensating controls are in place? Please list who at Redwood will be signing the attestation.

Appreciate it,
Jenna Lowe
Senior Security Analyst
BlueRidge Financial
[BlueRidge compliance intake ticket: BR-SEC-2027-1129]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Lowe <jenna.lowe@blueridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG/CAIQ review (scan cadence / SLA exceptions)

Jenna,

Thanks — we can do that. Brief plan:
- Attachments: redwood_scan_matrix.csv (cadence by tier), patch_manifest_June2027.pdf (sample remediations), scan-summary-202707.zip (scan exports).
- SLA table: Critical: 7 days, High: 14 days, Medium: 45 days (with documented compensating controls), Low: 90 days. Exceptions are captured via our Exception Acceptance workflow (DocuSign link provided below).
- Attestation: we will provide a one-page signed attestation PDF (vm_attestation_signed.pdf) signed by our Head of Security (Laura Bennett) and include a short audit trail.

On the 45-day question: we will accept a 45-day window for Medium risk only when documented compensating controls are validated and an exception is approved through the Exception Acceptance workflow. Critical and High require shorter windows as above. We'll include a short narrative describing the compensating controls we require.

Timeline: we'll send the artifacts + attestation for your EOD 7/16 deadline — draft artifacts attached.

Next steps: please confirm the asset scope (do you want infra images included, or only customer-facing prod assets?).

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: scan-summary-202707.zip (zip, 2.1MB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Lowe <jenna.lowe@blueridge.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG/CAIQ review (scan cadence / SLA exceptions)

Hi Jenna — adding technical detail to support the packet below.

1) Scan cadence (see redwood_scan_matrix.csv attached) — summary:
   - Prod customer-facing: nightly dynamic scans + weekly credentialed agent-based scans; monthly SCA/OSS composition.
   - Staging/preprod: nightly agent scans + weekly DAST where applicable.
   - Infra (control plane, management nodes): weekly agent-based + daily light heuristics for new critical updates.

2) SLA and escalation flow:
   - Critical (CVE score >=9): 7-day remediation target. Immediate on-call page + ticket created in our tracking system (SEC-XXXX).
   - High (7-8.9): 14-day target, auto-escalate to oncall + eng manager if not patched in 10 days.
   - Medium (4-6.9): 45-day target allowed with exception and compensating control documentation (network segmentation, WAF rules, additional monitoring).
   - Low (<4): 90 days.

3) Remediation evidence: attached patch_manifest_June2027.pdf (sample of 12 resolved CVEs across prod services) and ticket links exported in scan-summary-202707.zip. Notable resolved CVEs from May/June: CVE-2027-1456 (webserver), CVE-2027-1981 (openssl lib) — both closed and verified in staging + canary before full rollout.

4) Legacy dependency exceptions: One legacy dependency was raised (internal component: legacy-analytics-lib v0.9). We implemented microsegmentation and increased EDR telemetry; exception was approved June 10 and will be re-evaluated during the August replatforming sprint.

Attachments: redwood_scan_matrix.csv (cadence), patch_manifest_June2027.pdf (manifest).

Let me know if you need logs or ticket IDs exported in a different format — we can export a narrow CSV of ticket ids and verification steps.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer — Vulnerability Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_scan_matrix.csv (csv, 18KB)]

From: Jenna Lowe <jenna.lowe@blueridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueRidge Compliance Team <compliance@blueridge.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 12:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG/CAIQ review (scan cadence / SLA exceptions)

Thanks, Ben and Soojin — this is helpful. A couple of quick clarifications before we include in the SIG packet: 
1) For the legacy-analytics-lib exception, can you provide the DocuSign exception approval record or the ticket id for the exception approval? We need a signed record or change approval to include with compensating control narrative.
2) For the CVE list you mentioned (CVE-2027-1456, CVE-2027-1981), can you confirm the verification steps you ran in staging (smoke tests + regression checks) and a date/time snapshot for the verification?

We accept the proposed cadence and SLA table for the SIG; please include the signed attestation with Laura's signature. If you can provide the DocuSign link for the exception we can route internally to our risk committee.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we will target to include the attestation in the packet and aim to return any follow-up questions by Monday 7/19.

Best,
Jenna

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Lowe <jenna.lowe@blueridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG/CAIQ review (scan cadence / SLA exceptions)

Jenna — attached is the signed attestation (vm_attestation_signed.pdf) signed by Laura Bennett (Head of Security) and the DocuSign record for the legacy exception (link below).

Verification steps for the two CVEs:
- CVE-2027-1456 (webserver): patched in staging 2027-06-18 02:14 UTC; verification: smoke tests (ok), integration test suite run (no regressions), canary rollout to 5% traffic on 2027-06-20 10:30 UTC, full rollout 2027-06-21 03:50 UTC. Ticket: SEC-2027-4021.
- CVE-2027-1981 (openssl lib): patched in staging 2027-06-25 23:05 UTC; verification: credentialed scan pass, TLS matrix revalidation, canary at 10% on 2027-06-28 01:05 UTC. Ticket: SEC-2027-4087.

DocuSign exception (legacy-analytics-lib): https://www.docusign.net/rnd/BR-VM-EXC-2027 (record ID: DS-EXC-6612). Exception signed 2027-06-10 by Laura Bennett; compensating controls documented in ticket SEC-2027-3950. We will re-evaluate during the August replatforming sprint.

Attachments included: vm_attestation_signed.pdf, patch_manifest_June2027.pdf, redwood_scan_matrix.csv, scan-summary-202707.zip.

If BlueRidge wants the attestation on company letterhead we can generate that as well — let me know.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: vm_attestation_signed.pdf (pdf, 62KB), patch_manifest_June2027.pdf (pdf, 240KB), redwood_scan_matrix.csv (csv, 18KB), scan-summary-202707.zip (zip, 2.1MB)]
